curation_rules: Pin dataset revisions, byte sizes, and SHA-256 digests before any production run.
Deduplicate aggressively across sources; prefer educational quality over raw scale.
Keep instruction and identity corpora out of the pretrain mixture.
Record per-source token counts in the processed-data manifest after encoding.

sources.name: FineWeb-Edu
sources.notes: Educational web documents; primary quality signal for Cleo 1.1 pretraining.

sources.name: FineWeb
sources.notes: Broader web distribution to reduce FineWeb-Edu topic narrowness.

sources.name: Cosmopedia v2
sources.notes: Synthetic educational exposition from the SmolLM corpus mixture.

sources.name: Python-Edu
sources.notes: Educational Python from the SmolLM corpus; keep toxic or license-unclear code out.

stages.pretrain: FineWeb-Edu-led mixture until token budget is met

tokenizer.notes: Train a fresh 16K byte-level BPE; do not reuse the Cleo 1 1K tokenizer.
